title: Leche Flan
description: A dense, silky Filipino custard of egg yolks and condensed milk, steamed over dark caramel and turned out glossy.
notes: Traditionally made in an oval llanera; a 20 cm round tin works. Save the whites for meringues.

steps.text: Melt the sugar with the water in a small pan without stirring, swirling instead, until deep amber.
steps.tip: Take it a shade darker than feels safe — pale caramel only tastes sweet.

steps.text: Pour immediately into the llanera or tin and tilt to coat the base.
Stir the egg yolks gently with the condensed milk, evaporated milk, vanilla, and lime zest. Do not whisk in air.
Strain twice onto the caramel, cover tightly with foil, and steam until just set with a slight jiggle.
steps.tip: A rolling boil puts holes in it. The water should barely tremble.

steps.text: Run a knife around the edge and invert onto a plate with a lip to catch the syrup.
